summary: Improve board papers, KPI reporting, and executive presentations with practical five-day training. Explore the course and request details.
lede: Executive communication training helps report writers and senior leaders turn complex information into decision-ready board materials. Participants practise shaping decision papers, interpreting KPI trends and risk exposure, checking evidence and source limitations, and presenting recommendations; exercises also cover assurance reporting and human review of AI-assisted summaries. Governance frameworks serve as reference points, with practical introductions rather than implementation-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or present board-level information and need to make its implications and requested decisions clear.
modules: Board Reporting and OECD Governance Principles
Digital Drafting and AI Review Controls
prerequisites: Working familiarity with management reports, executive briefings, or board papers is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel and PowerPoint if you plan to complete the spreadsheet and presentation exercises; no specialist software is required.
